meta_description: Playford Steve is an experienced plasterer in Leeds offering interior and exterior plastering, rendering, and finishing. Call 07840 287682 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From small repairs to full interior and exterior plastering, Playford Steve delivers smooth, durable finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need patch repairs, full room renders, or exterior finishing, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, professional skimming and re-plastering for walls and ceilings. We leave surfaces ready for decoration without dust or mess.

services.title: Exterior Rendering & Finishing
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior renders and finishes that protect your masonry and improve kerb appeal. We work with traditional and modern finishes.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Fast, straight plasterboard fitting for new partitions, feature walls, and ceilings. Taped, jointed, and finished to a high standard.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Touch-Ups
services.desc: Quick repairs to cracks, holes, and damaged plaster. We blend seamlessly with existing surfaces so repairs are virtually invisible.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of dated Artex coatings and replacement with modern smooth plaster finishes that brighten rooms instantly.

services.title: Commercial & Domestic Projects
services.desc: From single-room renovations to large-scale commercial builds, we deliver consistent quality on schedule and within budget.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every job looking perfect, because your home deserves better.
about_para_1: Playford Steve has been plastering across Leeds and surrounding areas for nearly two decades. Started as a sole trader with a commitment to honest work and fair pricing, the business has built a strong reputation for reliability and quality finishes on everything from small domestic repairs to larger commercial projects.
about_para_2: Customers return to Steve because he listens, communicates clearly, and doesn't cut corners. He takes time to prepare surfaces properly and delivers smooth, long-lasting finishes that stand up to years of wear. Every job, big or small, receives the same level of care and attention to detail.

reviews.text: Had Steve round to skim out the main bedroom after some water damage. He sorted it properly, made sure it was smooth and ready for paint. Very tidy worker, no mess left behind. Would definitely use him again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: External render was cracking up badly. Steve quoted fair, did the work quickly, and the finish looks brilliant. Neighbours even asked for his number. Top lad, knows his stuff.
reviews.author: Lisa M.

reviews.text: Small plasterboard patch job turned out immaculate. You wouldn't know it'd been damaged. Steve's reliable, professional, and doesn't overcharge. Highly recommend him.
reviews.author: John W.
